description: This Kotlin source file defines a class 'PermissionRequester' that manages runtime permission requests in an Android application. It handles checking for permissions, requesting missing permissions, showing rationale dialogs, and guiding users to app settings if permissions are denied permanently. The class leverages AndroidX activity results, coroutines, and lifecycle-aware dialogs to facilitate complex permission workflows.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class that manages permission requests for an Android activity, providing methods to request permissions with user rationale and redirect to settings if needed.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests the specified permissions if they are not already granted, showing rationale dialogs if necessary and handling the user response.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining why the permissions are needed and waits for user to proceed or cancel.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Informs the user that permissions need to be enabled in app settings and provides a shortcut to the settings page.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Constructs a user-friendly message listing the permissions needing rationale.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message guiding users to enable permissions in settings.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Provides human-readable labels for specific Android permissions.
